summary: Executed backend+frontend verification for My Agents, onchain detail, register flow, and regression suite on public preview URL. Added targeted API tests; found one critical backend contract bug and one flaky sync-status condition.

critical.issue: Returns 500 Internal Server Error for missing token instead of required 404.

minor.issue: Intermittently reports status=running during startup sync; existing tests expecting immediate success are flaky (retry passed).

issues: `data-testid` prefix collision: container uses `onchain-agent-grid` and cards use `onchain-agent-*`, causing broad selectors to overcount card items and reducing test reliability.

action_items: Fix `/api/onchain/agent-details/{network}/{token}` to map upstream 404 into API 404 (not 500).
In `Scan8004Client._get`, convert upstream HTTP status errors (esp. 404) to controlled `Scan8004Error` handling or branch handling in route.
Stabilize status tests by allowing running/never_run transitional states or waiting for sync completion deterministically.
Use non-overlapping `data-testid` values for onchain grid container vs card items.
critical_code_review_comments: `onchain_agent_detail` only catches `Scan8004Error`; upstream `httpx.HTTPStatusError` (404) escapes and crashes request with 500.
Public missing-detail contract in requirements (404) is currently violated for high token IDs, reproducible on live endpoint.
Selector taxonomy should avoid shared test-id prefixes between wrappers and repeated row items to keep e2e assertions accurate.

success_rate.backend: 94.5% (52/55 in full run; two flaky status tests passed on retry; one persistent failure)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL tested: https://agent-marketplace-131.preview.emergentagent.com. New test file added: test_my_agents_detail_flows.py covering invalid wallet/network, network-isolated ownership, public detail fields, invalid network, and missing-detail expectation. Full pytest run produced 3 failures initially; two status-related failures were flaky and passed on immediate retry. Persistent repro: GET /api/onchain/agent-details/mainnet/999999999 -> 500. Frontend browser run passed: My Agents disconnected prompt, network select interaction, Onchain detail read-only (no edit button while disconnected), no horizontal overflow in tested detail page, register default Testnet + create/manage links + HTTPS warning + transaction preview content.
rca of the issue: RCA for critical bug: `/api/onchain/agent-details/{network}/{token}` calls `Scan8004Client.agent_detail()`, whose `_get()` raises `httpx.HTTPStatusError` for upstream 404. Route catches only `Scan8004Error`, so exception escapes and FastAPI returns 500. Reproduction: GET https://agent-marketplace-131.preview.emergentagent.com/api/onchain/agent-details/mainnet/999999999 returns 500 with backend log showing uncaught HTTPStatusError. Mitigation: catch `httpx.HTTPStatusError` (or wrap in `Scan8004Error`) and return 404 when upstream missing and cache also missing.
